import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p=params
    A2=A**2
    return (p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*np.sqrt(t) + p[3]*np.log(t) + p[4]*np.exp(-t) + p[5]*t + p[6]*t**2
            + A2*(p[7] + p[8]*np.sqrt(t) + p[9]/t))
